load_policy: Read LOCAL-NOTES.md and the complete SKILL.md of the selected expert only. These names are directory names, not registered skill() capabilities.

routes.deliverable: A short written triage: column types, missingness by column, duplicate keys, suspicious leakage columns, and the split unit to use.
A reproducible baseline with a declared split, cross-validated score, holdout score, and the fitted pipeline saved.
A deterministic figure file plus the values it plots, at readable size.

rules: Triage before training: a baseline on an unaudited table is a number without meaning.
One split definition, decided before any model sees the data.
Report the holdout once; do not tune against it.
A figure must be reproducible from saved numbers, not from a screenshot.
